A Belgrave team went to Birmingham on July 14th to compete in Lewis's 25 miles walk, but with Green an absentee and Rickards barely recovered from a very severe chill, we were not too strong. Eventually, our team finished third, Fred Bentley finishing second to Lloyd Johnson in the individual race.
